request: Fix the pagination that drops the last item on each page.
dealbreakers: - Off-by-one in paginate() drops the last item of every page → **resolved by** using an exclusive end index (start+size), not start+size-1
diff:
--- a/app/paginate.py
+++ b/app/paginate.py
@@ def paginate(items, start, size):
-    return items[start:start + size - 1]
+    return items[start:start + size]
rationale: Control case: the diff is exactly the fix the verdict called for, nothing more. A calibrated verifier must CONFORM here — a verifier that FAILS this is crying wolf (over-firing), which is as miscalibrated as rubber-stamping.
